comment: The maker's own tooltip and manual give the thresholds as approximately 4.6V and 7V. The stored constants are 0.38 and 0.58 of a 12V supply (CMOSInput.hpp:31-32, Utility.hpp:9), which is 4.56V and 6.96V. This is the only module in the plugin that does not run at the plugin's standard 0.1V/2V thresholds and 10V outputs, because it is the only one that selects its own mode and the only one with no dataFromJson override to reset that mode when a patch is loaded.
